libraryEditor.thisIsWhatArc: This is what Arc found, before adding anything. Your files are never changed.
libraryEditor.folderChangesScanThe: Folder changes scan the library. Metadata changes refresh known titles.
libraryEditor.chooseATypeAnd: Choose a type and folders. Arc finds titles, matches them and loads artwork in the background.
libraryEditor.whatThisLibraryIs: What this library is called in the sidebar and on Home.
libraryEditor.whatKindOfVideos: What kind of videos this library holds, and what to call it.
libraryEditor.homeVideosAndAnything: Home videos and anything else that isn't a film or show: named from their files, dated by them, nothing looked up online. Each folder becomes a collection.
libraryEditor.name: Name
libraryEditor.arcLooksInThese: Arc looks in these folders and everything inside them. Your files are never changed.
libraryEditor.metadataCollectionsAndPlayer: Metadata, collections and player features for this library.
libraryEditor.optionalTheDefaultsSuit: Optional. The defaults suit most libraries, and you can change them later.
libraryEditor.titlesAndDescriptionsIn: Titles and descriptions in this language. Anything not translated yet is shown in English.
libraryEditor.theLanguageTitlesAnd: The language titles and descriptions are shown in.
libraryEditor.everythingInTheLibrary: Everything in the library is fetched again after you save.
libraryEditor.whichCountrySAge: Which country's age ratings (like 12A or PG-13) to show and use for parental controls.
libraryEditor.detailsAreFetchedAgain: Details are fetched again after you save.
libraryEditor.optionalSeeWhatArc: Optional: see what Arc would find before adding the library.
libraryEditor.anythingNotIdentifiedCan: Anything not identified can be fixed after adding, with Identify.
libraryEditor.noVideoFilesIn: No video files in these folders. Check it's the folder with your videos in it. If Arc runs in Docker, the folder must be mounted into the container (e.g. /media/movies) and chosen by that name here.
libraryEditor.theseFilesHaveNo: These files have no season and episode in their names (like “S01E02”), so Arc can’t place them.
libraryEditor.arcCouldnTTell: Arc couldn’t tell what these files are.

folderPicker.chooseADriveOr: Choose a drive, or type a folder path

grid.collection: Show the collection instead of its titles
grid.both: Show the collection and its titles

help.fileOrder: {{hint}}. Episode details come from the same provider. A show can override this in its Edit dialog; display order is separate.
help.metadataProvider: Where show titles, descriptions, artwork and cast come from.
help.automaticCollections: Films TMDB groups together, like a trilogy, become a collection once you have this many.
help.collectionGrid: How collections appear when you browse the whole library. Each collection can choose for itself.
help.scrubbingPreviews: A picture while dragging along the timeline. Made in the background, about 5 MB per film; turning this off deletes them.
help.skipMarkers: Offer Skip Intro and Skip Recap, found from chapters, online databases or by comparing a season's episodes.
help.showCredits: Offer Skip Credits, and start the Up Next countdown when the credits begin.
help.movieCredits: Offer Skip Credits, found from chapters, TheIntroDB or by spotting the closing credits at night.

sourceHints.tmdbAired: Files numbered the way TMDB lists them
sourceHints.tvdbAired: Files numbered the way TheTVDB lists them (Sonarr's default)
sourceHints.tvdbDvd: Files numbered like the DVD releases
sourceHints.tvdbAbsolute: Episodes numbered 1, 2, 3… across seasons (common for anime)

preview.unavailable: Couldn't open {{paths}}. Is the drive connected?
preview.foundExtras_one: {{count}} video file found, plus {{extras}} (trailers, featurettes, samples) that are skipped.
preview.foundExtras_other: {{count}} video files found, plus {{extras}} (trailers, featurettes, samples) that are skipped.
preview.scanning_one: Looking through your folders… {{count}} video file so far
preview.scanning_other: Looking through your folders… {{count}} video files so far
